$meta.description: Concept table. Primary key for the registry system: definitions, formulas, rules, methods, visual-tools, calculators, pages, sections, relations and aliases all join on concepts.id.
$meta.idRule: snake_case, apostrophes stripped, globally unique. Same concept in two sections = one record with alsoIn. Different concepts sharing a name = qualifier-first id.
$meta.gate: Concepts only. Theorems, laws, rules and tests belong in rules.json; procedures and algorithms in methods.json. Excluded entries are written to parked-rules-methods.json.
$meta.handWrittenFields: none — aliases beyond parentheticals, symbol, plural and level are owned by separate overlay tables
